We’re hiring Field Engineers focused on Healthcare to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. 31d6a5d88d5d0b4a.description: Designation: Finance Analyst - Pricing & Financial Modeling Location: Ambattur, Chennai Job Description This role is primarily focused on FP&A;, pricing analysis, financial modeling, and scenario / what-if analysis. The Finance Analyst will build and maintain robust, decision-ready financial models, run scenario-based analyses to support pricing and business decisions, and provide the analytical backbone for FP&A; reporting. Advanced Excel modeling skills are essential to this role. The candidate will partner closely with Finance, Solutions, Operations, and leadership to translate business questions into structured financial models and scenarios. Key Responsibilities: Pricing, Modeling & Scenario Analysis (Core Focus) - Own end-to-end financial model development and maintenance, including integrated revenue, expense, and headcount models. - Build and maintain pricing models, including deal-level and customer-level pricing analysis. - Design and run scenario-based / what-if models to evaluate the financial impact of pricing changes, cost structures, and business decisions. - Perform sensitivity analysis on key business drivers (volume, price, cost, mix) to support leadership decision-making. - Support ad hoc initiatives including pricing strategy, deal evaluation, and acquisition-related financial modeling and scenario analysis. - Develop and automate dashboards, KPI reporting, and streamlined data flows to support modeling and scenario work across systems. FP&A;, Reporting & Planning Support - Prepare project-level cost reporting and insights. - Prepare COGS and operating expense (Opex) variance analysis reports. - Prepare customer- and vertical-level margin reporting. - Deliver performance insights and executive-level reporting, including variance analysis. - Manage monthly and quarterly forecasting cycles with cross-functional alignment. - Drive the annual budgeting process in coordination with internal and outsourced accounting teams. - Partner across teams to improve data quality, governance, and system integration. Requirements - Very strong, hands-on Excel skills are essential advanced financial modeling, scenario-based modeling, and what-if analysis (sensitivity tables, data tables, scenario manager, dynamic driver-based models). - Demonstrated experience building pricing models and conducting pricing analysis. - Demonstrated expertise in financial modelling, planning systems, and performance reporting. - Strong understanding of budgeting cycles, forecasting processes, and financial governance. - Strong analytical thinking, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable financial models and automation. - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to partner with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. - Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate effectively with outsourced/shared service teams. - Experience in healthcare services, and/or PE-backed environments is an advantage. Qualifications - Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field. - Qualified certifications (e.g., CFA, CMA) or an MBA (Finance) are preferred but not required. - Subject Matter Expert in Excel advanced financial modeling, scenario/what-if analysis, and pricing models; Google Sheets modeling experience is also acceptable. BI experience (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) is preferred. - 5 to 10 years of experience in FP&A;, pricing, strategic finance, or financial modeling roles. .

3119652ee6409222.description: ### Build the Category-Defining Brand in Telecom Infrastructure Commerce became programmable with Shopify. Payments became programmable with Stripe. Telecom is now undergoing the same shift. Spenza is building the infrastructure layer that makes connectivity programmable, embeddable, and scalable for modern enterprises. Spenza is a “Telecom as a Service” platform that enables Enterprises, OEMs, IoT companies, and MVNOs to launch and monetize connectivity services without building telecom infrastructure from scratch. **Think of us as “Shopify for Telecom.”** Instead of spending years integrating operators, billing systems, provisioning stacks, and compliance workflows, companies use Spenza to embed connectivity directly into their products and customer experiences. Our customers — including Angel Watch, Butlr, and Rocket Phone — bundle mobile connectivity alongside their devices and services. Spenza has successfully navigated the 0→1 journey and is now scaling through the 1→10 phase with global ambitions across enterprise connectivity, embedded telecom, eSIM orchestration, and programmable infrastructure. We are looking for a high-agency Product Marketing Manager who wants to help shape how the market understands the future of telecom. ### The Opportunity This is not a traditional marketing role. This is a category creation role. You will help define: * How enterprises think about programmable telecom and launch telecom -native products * How embedded connectivity products are positioned globally * How Spenza differentiates against legacy telecom platforms and MVNEs * How the next generation of telecom infrastructure companies communicate value * How Spenza platform can enable seamless cloud based AI services - think agents with phone numbers You should be equally comfortable: * Explaining Spenza’s differentiated architecture and market positioning to an industry analyst * Creating compelling messaging for enterprise buyers and partners * Writing high-conviction product narratives and launch content * Building thought leadership around APIs, embedded connectivity, and Telecom-as-a-Service * Representing Spenza at conferences, customer meetings, webinars, and ecosystem conversations * You will work directly with founders across positioning, GTM strategy, product launches, outbound initiatives, analyst conversations, and market education. * This role is ideal for someone who wants to become one of the defining product marketers in the infrastructure/API economy over the next decade. ### What You’ll Own **Category Positioning & Product Narrative** * Define and evolve Spenza’s positioning in the Telecom-as-a-Service, MVNE, and connectivity infrastructure landscape * Build differentiated messaging against legacy carrier and telecom platforms * Translate complex telecom and infrastructure concepts into clear customer value propositions * Shape the narrative around embedded connectivity, eSIM orchestration, and programmable telecom. **Product Marketing** * Own product launches, messaging frameworks, pitch decks, battle cards, customer stories, and GTM assets * Partner closely with product, founders, sales, and engineering teams * Influence how products are packaged, presented, and brought to market **Brand, Content & Thought Leadership** * Lead Spenza’s website messaging and narrative architecture * Create exceptional long-form and short-form content across blogs, landing pages, LinkedIn, webinars, and sales enablement * Drive market education around telecom APIs, embedded connectivity, IoT, and enterprise telecom workflows * Build organic inbound momentum through strong content and SEO strategy **Industry Presence** * Represent Spenza in analyst briefings, conferences, ecosystem events, and customer conversations * Stay deeply informed about telecom infrastructure, connectivity management, IoT, APIs, eSIMs, and enterprise SaaS trends * Help establish Spenza as a market-defining voice in the industry ### What We’re Looking For **Must-Have** * 2+ years of experience in Product Marketing, B2B SaaS Marketing, Growth Marketing, or a similar high-ownership role * Experience working in SaaS or technology companies selling into US/global markets * Exceptional communication and storytelling skills * Ability to simplify technically complex concepts into compelling market narratives * Strong product intuition and positioning ability * High ownership mindset with strong execution velocity * Curiosity about infrastructure, APIs, telecom, IoT, SaaS, and emerging technology platforms * Builder mentality with comfort operating in ambiguity * Sell first- Ship fast mindset. * Strong work ethic and achievement orientation * Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate for an in-office role **Nice-to-Have** * MBA from a reputed institution * Exposure to telecom, APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or embedded systems * Experience working closely with founders or early-stage startups * US Visa / ability to travel internationally for conferences and customer meetings * Strong sense of craft in messaging, positioning, and product storytelling ### Why Spenza? * Opportunity to help define a new category in global telecom infrastructure * Direct founder collaboration and high strategic visibility * Build a breakout global B2B technology brand from India * Work at the intersection of telecom, APIs, embedded connectivity, IoT, and enterprise infrastructure software * High ownership with meaningful influence on company trajectory * Fast-moving environment with ambitious global goals and real customer traction We care more about clarity of thought, market intuition, execution speed, and ownership than polished corporate process. If you want to build, shape markets, and help define the future of programmable telecom infrastructure, we’d love to talk.
